summary: macOS worker ingress now validates the Unix connector's LOCAL_PEERPID against a proc_pidinfo process-birth witness, including explicit foreground worker enrollment.

compatibility.detail: No wire shape change. macOS follows the existing worker_ingress_generation_check observe/enforce policy instead of bypassing generation checks. macOS has no pidfd: birth-time revalidation narrows but cannot eliminate the PID reuse window.

downtime.detail: Takes effect after daemon restart with the new build.

manual.detail: Existing observe-first rollout policy remains unchanged; enforcement remains an explicit operator choice.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit and restart the daemon.
